name: ai-code-diff-assistant
description: VS Code extension for efficient AI playground prompt workflow & incremental diff patching.

commands.title: AI Assistant: Copy Project Context & System Prompt
AI Assistant: Copy Project Structure Only
AI Assistant: Apply AI Code Response

aiDiffAssistant.excludeFolders.markdownDescription: Folders excluded from the exported project context. When non-empty, this list **replaces** the built-in defaults (`node_modules`, `.git`, `dist`, `out`, …). Example: `["node_modules", ".git", "tmp"]`.

aiDiffAssistant.excludeFiles.markdownDescription: File globs excluded from the exported project context (supports `*` and `?`). When non-empty, this list **replaces** the built-in defaults (`*.log`, `*.png`, `package-lock.json`, …). Example: `["*.log", "*.png", "secrets.json"]`.
